scope: One admitted short-prefix VP8L primitive, one frozen literal/run input from the existing original 513x259 RGBA8 raster. Warm single CPU public decode to independent owned output; no uniform parity claim.
changedPrimitive: Generate a power-of-two lookup for canonical codes of at most eight bits, using LSB-first byte fields and packed symbol/length entries. Smaller trees use their maximum code width; single leaves and wholly longer trees allocate no lookup. Admit added storage and bounded construction work before allocation. Read only bytes required by a complete code and admit its original logical bit cost. Long codes, incomplete input and tight work budgets retain canonical one-bit traversal without speculative state changes. No decoded-pixel cache, native binding, dependency or unsafe code.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident frozen VP8L input to independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode, output acquisition/disposal; native software webp decode, state reset, ARGB-to-RGBA conversion, owned output allocation/release. Native codec/conversion contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts every pixel. Padded native rows exposed without an extra packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation/encoding, hashing and validation excluded. Exact original RGBA, alpha and hidden RGB. One existing raster; no quality enumeration. Only this literal/run VP8L profile is measured.

uncertainty: Short BenchmarkDotNet screens with three actual managed iterations and three native samples on either side. Ratio uses the faster native bracket mean. Conservative upper divides the managed BDN confidence upper by the smaller native mean minus the same t multiplier times its standard error. Failed post-run rolling-load observations and later passing cooldowns remain visible. Neither short screens nor current quietness certify every codec/path or future hypervisor isolation.
